title: Ziyarat of Imam Ali Hadi
urduTitle: زیارت امام علی ہادی علیہ السلام
intro: The individual ziyarat of Imam Ali al-Hadi at Samarra, kept separate from the combined Askariyyayn text.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Ali Hadi with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:

Specific Izn Dukhool |

Ziyarat

Specific Recitation at the entrance

blocks.english: May I enter, O Prophet of Allah?
May I enter, O Commander of the Faithful?
May I enter, O Fatimah the luminous
and the doyenne of the women of the world?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ ٱلْحَسَنُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya alhasanu bna Aliyyin
blocks.english: May I enter, O my master al-Hasan the son of Ali?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ ٱلْحُسَيْنُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya alhusaynu bna Aliyyin
blocks.english: May I enter, O my master al-Husayn the son of Ali?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ عَلِيُّ بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya Aliyyu bna alhusayni
blocks.english: May I enter, O my master Ali the son of al-Husayn?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya muhammadu bna Aliyyin
blocks.english: May I enter, O my master Muhammad the son of Ali?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ جَعْفَرُ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya ja`faru bna muhammadin
blocks.english: May I enter, O my master Ja`far the son of Muhammad?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ مُوسَىٰ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya musa bna ja`farin
blocks.english: May I enter, O my master Musa the son of Ja`far?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ عَلِيُّ بْنَ مُوسَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya Aliyyu bna musa
blocks.english: May I enter, O my master Ali the son of Musa?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya muhammadu bna Aliyyin
blocks.english: May I enter, O my master Muhammad the son of Ali?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا ابَا ٱلْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya ya aba alhasani Aliyyu bna muhammadin
blocks.english: May I enter, O my master Abul-Hasan Ali the son of Muhammad?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا ابَا مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْحَسَنُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya ya aba muhammadin alhasanu bna Aliyyin
blocks.english: May I enter, O my master Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan the son of Ali?
May I enter, O angels of Allah
whom are assigned to manage this holy sanctuary?

blocks.text: You may then enter the holy shrine preceding your right foot to the left. When you stop on the tomb of Imam Abul-Hasan al-Hadi, peace be upon him, directing your face towards the tomb and your back towards the kiblah direction, you may repeat one hundred times:

blocks.english: Allah is the Most Great.

blocks.text: You may then say the following

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Abul-Hasan
Ali the son of Muhammad,
the pious, right-directing,
and brightly shining light.
Allahs mercy and blessings be upon you.
Peace be upon you, O sincerely attached friend of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O confidant of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O rope of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O household of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O select of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O choice of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O trustee of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O proof of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O most-beloved by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O light of the lights.
Peace be upon you, O pride of the virtuous ones.
Peace be upon you, O descendant of the upright ones.
Peace be upon you, O essence of the purified ones.
Peace be upon you, O argument of the All-beneficent God.
Peace be upon you, O essence of the true faith.
Peace be upon you, O master of the believers.
Peace be upon you, O guardian of the righteous ones.
Peace be upon you, O symbol of true guidance.
Peace be upon you, O ally of piety.
Peace be upon you, O mainstay of the religion.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ خَاتَمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the seal of the Prophets.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the Prophets successors.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah the Luminous
and the doyenne of the women of the world.
Peace be upon you, O faithful trustee.
Peace be upon you, O favorite epitome.
Peace be upon you, O ascetic and pious.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ايُّهَا ٱلْحُجَّةُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْخَلْقِ اجْمَعِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu Alayka ayyuha alhujjatu Ala alkhalqi ajma`ina
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O decisive argument against all creatures.
Peace be upon you, O succeeding of the Qur'an.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ايُّهَا ٱلْمُبَيِّنُ لِلْحَلاَلِ مِنَ ٱلْحَرَامِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu Alayka ayyuha almubayyinu lilhalali min alharami
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O distinguishing between the lawful and the unlawful.
Peace be upon you, O sincere saint.
Peace be upon you, O evident course.
Peace be upon you, O bright star.

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا ابَا ٱلْحَسَنِ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu ya mawlaya ya aba alhasani
blocks.english: I bear witness, O my master Abul-Hasan,
that you are verily the decisive argument of Allah against His creatures,
His representative among His created beings,
His trusted administrator in His lands,
and His witness over His servants.
I also bear witness that you are verily the word of piety,
the door to true guidance,
the Firmest Handle,
and the evident proof against those who are on the earth
and those who are beneath the layers of the soil.

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka almutahharu min aldhdhunubi
blocks.english: I bear witness that you are purified from sins,
cleaned against defects,
bestowed with the honor of Allah,
endued with the proof of Allah,
granted the Word of Allah,
and the stronghold to whom the servants (of Allah) resort
and by whom the lands are revived.
I bear witness, O my master,

blocks.arabic: انِّي بِكَ وَبِآبَائِكَ وَابْنَائِكَ مُوقِنٌ مُقِرٌّ
blocks.transliteration: anni bika wa bi'aba'ika wa abna'ika muqinun muqirrun
blocks.english: that I have faith in and I submit to  you, your forefathers and your sons,

blocks.transliteration: wa lakum tabi`un fi dhati nafsi
blocks.english: I follow all of you in my personal affairs,
in my religious performance,
in the seals of my deed,
and in my return and final place.
I do show loyalty to your loyalists,
I show enmity towards your enemies,
I believe in all of the invisible and the visible,
and the first and the last of you.
May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you.

blocks.transliteration: walssalamu Alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace and Allahs mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.text: You may then kiss the tomb and place your right and then left cheeks on it and say the following words:

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma Ľalli Ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and send blessings upon Your faithful demonstrator,
Your sagacious representative,
Your well-pleased trustee,
Your sincerely attached guide,
Your Right Path,
the most important approach,
the just and equitable course,
the light of the faithful believers hearts,
the friend of the pious ones,
and the comrade of the sincere.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَاهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma Ľalli Ala sayyidina muhammadin wa ahli baytihi
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon our Master Muhammad and upon his Household

blocks.transliteration: wa Ľalli Ala Aliyyi bni muhammadin
blocks.english: and send blessings upon Ali the son of Muhammad,
the rightly-directing, the infallible guide,
the free from defects,
who, putting hope in You, kept himself aloof from temptations,
who was tried (by You) through seditious matters,
who was tested (by You) through tribulations,
who was examined (by You) through acting excellently towards misfortunes,
and through steadfastness against complaining;
(he is) the spiritual guide of Your servants,
the blessing for Your lands,
the destination of Your mercy,
the hoarder of Your wisdom,
the leader to Your Paradise,
the all-knowledgeable among Your created beings,
the true guide of Your creatures,
whom You pleased, preferred,
selected to take the place of Your Prophet among his people,
and bounded with the guardianship of his laws.
So, he accomplished the onerous task of representation (of the Prophet),
carrying it perfectly,
and undertaking the responsibility of bearing it.
He neither slipped in any problematic action
nor did he fail to solve any complexity.
Rather, he relieved all agonies,
sealed the loopholes,
and fulfilled the required.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا اقْرَرْتَ نَاظِرَ نَبِيِّكَ بِهِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma fakama aqrarta nazira nabiyyika bihi
blocks.english: O Allah, just as You made him a source of delight for Your Prophet,
so also (please) raise him to the most elevated position,
give him the most fitting reward that suits him,
bless him,

blocks.transliteration: wa ballighhu minna tahiyyatan wa salaman
blocks.english: convey our greetings and salutations to him,

blocks.arabic: وَآتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فِي مُوَالاَتِهِ فَضْلاًَ وَإِِحْسَاناً
blocks.transliteration: wa atina min ladunka fi muwalatihi fadlan wa ihsanan
blocks.english: and give us, on account of our love for him, from You bounties, favors,
amnesty, and approval.
Verily, You are the Lord of superabundant favors.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام علی ہادی علیہ السلام کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
